description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmploymentStatusAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods for CRUD operations (getAll, getOne, create, update, delete) on the EmploymentStatus API endpoint, utilizing test data from a YAML data provider.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the EmploymentStatusAPI endpoints in various CRUD operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by truncating relevant tables and loading test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API endpoint for retrieving all employment status entries.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for 'getAll' endpoint tests from a YAML file.
